name: Lukos
appearance: He has a tall, narrow triangle silhouette with a long snout, sloped shoulders, and a tapering tail. His fur is charcoal gray with ash highlights, with pale chest and muzzle and yellow-amber eyes. His ears are upright with a small notch in the right ear, and a single small fang sometimes peeks when he smiles slyly. He wears a ragged dark hooded himation or cloak tied with a cord, worn sandals, a frayed rust-red scarf, and a small belt pouch, and he sometimes carries a crooked walking stick.
